catalysts.headline: CIFR shares rose 18.4%, rebounding after having lost 47.5% over the prior month into Nov 3, outpacing a 0.4% gain for the S&P 500

catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 results: revenue $26.70M (down ~62.8% YoY), loss of $0.22 per share, reported as beating consensus estimates

Cipher Digital reported Q3 2026 results: revenue $26.7M (down ~62.8% YoY from ~$71.7M in Q3 2025, missing a ~$39.3M consensus); GAAP diluted EPS -$0.22 (beat -$0.25/-$0.26 consensus by ~$0.04); net income $31.6M, driven by a $127.2M non-cash warrant-revaluation gain (vs. a $3.28M net loss a year earlier); adjusted EBITDA -$10M. First HPC lease revenue recognized from the Black Pearl campus. Odessa site produced ~296 BTC (207MW capacity, ~17.2 J/TH fleet efficiency); sold 632 BTC for $45.5M (realized gain ~$0.5M). Company now cites 3 contracted HPC campuses totaling 700MW and ~$16.6B of contracted revenue, after amending the Barber Lake lease (extended term, added an AI lab as a direct tenant) to lift that site's own contracted revenue to ~$9.1B. Pro forma unrestricted cash ~$724M as of 2026-09-30.
catalysts.impact: Stock rose on the print; magnitude disputed across sources -- see conflicts

catalysts.headline: Announced a plan to sell $850M of 0% convertible senior notes due 2032 (initial conversion price $15.31/share, with a 13-day greenshoe for an additional $150M); priced the notes 2026-10-14 while concurrently exchanging roughly $166M of its existing 2030 convertible notes for about 41M shares of common stock. Proceeds earmarked partly for capped-call transactions (to limit dilution) and partly for the Barber Lake project and HPC pipeline build-out.
catalysts.impact: Stock fell sharply on the announcement — reported as its worst session in six months, with one source citing an ~18% single-day decline

catalysts.headline: Wells Fargo initiates coverage of Cipher Mining (CIFR) with an Overweight rating and $25 price target
catalysts.impact: Positive sell-side sentiment ahead of the ERCOT grid-capacity news

catalysts.headline: ERCOT's 'Batch Zero' interconnection review validates ~3.2 GW of grid capacity across Cipher's Texas data-center portfolio (six facilities), including conditional baseload designations for Stingray (100 MW) and Colchis (1 GW); stock rose ~14% intraday to $17.58
catalysts.impact: Validates large-scale AI/HPC datacenter colocation pivot; company expects to satisfy audit conditions and finalize site designations by December 2026
catalysts.source: secondary coverage (financialmodelingprep.com, pro.edgex.exchange); this corroborates the on-file catalyst though a primary Cipher press release could not be independently located/fetched in this sandbox

catalysts.headline: ERCOT's 'Batch Zero' process granted Cipher a conditional 3.2 GW Texas baseload grid classification, supporting its pivot from bitcoin mining toward higher-margin AI data-center colocation
Cipher Mining reports Q2 2026 results: EPS -$0.65 (vs. -$0.24 est.), revenue $24.84M (vs. $33.16M est.)
catalysts.impact: Earnings and revenue miss; stock reportedly fell on rising-debt-pressure concerns tied to the data-center buildout financing

catalysts.headline: Company states it began delivering data-center capacity at the start of August 2026, roughly two months ahead of its original schedule; also acquired an option on a new ~900 MW 'Apollo' site near San Antonio, TX
